summary_markdown:
The session focused on synchronizing historical data discrepancies across multiple client accounts. Multiple batches of inventory data were manually updated/transferred to the production environment for various companies (e.g., AFA, JCDecaux UK, Bauer Media Outdoor Suomi Oy). The transfers covered dates like 2025-09-16 and included specific considerations for clients with active development or limited discrepancies.

Separately, a discussion occurred regarding the modification of a data script (likely related to traffic prediction/data source access). It was decided that the script should be updated to use 'dav' for local execution while accessing S3 directly when run via Rundeck. Best practices for code management were reviewed, emphasizing using pull requests (PRs) rather than direct edits to the master branch.
decisions: Multiple batches of inventory data discrepancies were manually transferred/updated to production for various listed client accounts.
The data script will be modified to use 'dav' locally and S3 directly on Rundeck.
